en.description: Sol, Terra, and Luna map to meeting depth — built into Floatboat with no API keys. Notes on which tier each calendar event deserves, so cost follows the task.

zh.title: 按会议轻重挑 GPT-5.6 档位
zh.description: Sol 扛硬活、Terra 做日常、Luna 跑分类，三档内置、无需 API key。来信讲怎么让模型成本跟着日历事件走。

en.title: Grok 3 API: Cheap for Whom, Really?
en.description: "Open" means API access, not open-source weights — and Grok 3 is not the budget pick; Mini and Fast are. When a solo token bill justifies switching.

zh.title: 换 Grok API 前，先算清这笔账
zh.description: 接口开放不等于权重开源，Grok 3 也不算平价——Mini 与 Fast 才是。来信拆解月账单到什么量级才值得换。

en.title: Your First Agent Should Be Boring
en.description: Skip the grand vision; pick one job you do three times a week and map its decisions. This framework shipped a working agent in a day.

zh.title: 第一个 Agent 就该做件无聊的活
zh.description: 挑一件每周重复三次的活，画清输入、判断、输出，别一上来搭大戏。来信还原这套当天跑通的框架。

en.title: Readable AI Output: HTML Over Markdown?
en.description: An agent artifact written for human eyes needs more than a wall of text. We test where HTML earns its tokens, and where Markdown still wins.

zh.title: AI 产物要给人读，格式值得重想
zh.description: AI 产出若供人阅读，带侧栏与色标的 HTML 往往比整墙文字耐看。来信拆解它与 Markdown 的取舍。

en.title: Lindy vs Gumloop: Which Fits Your Pipeline
en.description: Built the same research-to-draft pipeline on both — Lindy set up three times faster, Gumloop sharper after tuning. Side-by-side notes on speed, control, and credit burn.

zh.title: 同一内容管线：Lindy 快，还是 Gumloop 精
zh.description: 同一条研究转成稿管线：一边十分钟跑通，一边精调后更像你。来信还原速度、可控性与积分对照。

en.title: More Parallel Agents or Stricter Process?
en.description: oh-my-codex multiplies Codex workers with durable state; Superpowers installs planning and TDD into any agent. Notes on choosing leverage when you are the whole team.

zh.title: 要更多并行 Agent，还是更严的流程
zh.description: 一边让多个 Codex 并行、状态可续；一边给任意 Agent 装规划与 TDD。来信聊一人团队先该补哪块短板。

en.title: Charge from Day One: Pricing Is a Signal
en.description: Free clients flatter you; paying clients tell you what the offer is really worth. A case for naming a number early and reading what the market answers.

zh.title: 定价从第一天开始，它是一枚信号
zh.description: 免费客户只说好话，付费客户的异议才是真反馈。来信讲怎么早定第一个价，并读懂市场的回答。

en.title: Claude Code Explained: The Agent with Checkpoints
en.description: A local coding agent that plans read-only, spawns sub-agents, and asks before it touches anything. A grounded definition for deciding whether that loop fits how you ship.

zh.title: 看懂 Claude Code：本地编码 Agent 怎么把关
zh.description: 只读规划、子 Agent、改码前先要权限，本地编码 Agent 靠检查点自证可靠。来信拆解它与聊天界面的差别。

en.title: MiniMax H3: One Model, Picture and Sound
en.description: Text, clips, and audio in one context return as a clip with stereo sound — no stitching. What open weights change for small video teams, and the 2K ceiling.

zh.title: MiniMax H3：一个模型同出画面与声音
zh.description: 文字、片段与音频进同一上下文，出来是带立体声的成片，不必拼工具链。来信聊开源权重与 2K 上限。

en.title: What You Lose When Your AI Forgets You
en.description: Each new chat resets to zero, and solo operators pay the re-explanation tax hardest. Notes on what stateless AI costs, and what real memory should look like.

zh.title: AI 每次归零，你在替它交什么税
zh.description: 新会话即清零，单人运营的「重新解释税」最贵。来信算清无状态 AI 的账，并讲挑记忆工具该看什么。

en.title: Fill Your 2026 Bracket by Reading the Path
en.description: A champion pick is not bracketology; the path is. Round-of-32 fatigue, upset zones, and keeping facts apart from opinions — ways to fill a bracket you can defend.

zh.title: 填 2026 签表，先读懂八强之路
zh.description: 选冠军不算对阵解析，读懂路径才算。来信拆解 32 强消耗、冷门区与事实分层，填一张敢拿出手的签表。

en.title: Never Miss a USMNT Kickoff This Summer
en.description: Three group games, all at 7:00 PM Pacific — one timezone slip costs the first half. Get kickoff times and calendar reminders for a US home World Cup.

zh.title: USMNT 三场都在西部开球，别错过
zh.description: 三场都在太平洋时间 19:00 开球，时差错一步就错过上半场。订阅收开球时间、主办城市与日历提醒。

en.title: DeepSeek V4.1 Flash: the 48-hour beta
en.description: Two-day betas with self-expiring model IDs are the new release pattern. Notes on what V4.1 Flash's native multimodal and 300+ tokens/s mean if Flash is meant to replace Pro.

zh.title: DeepSeek V4.1 Flash：48 小时实验
zh.description: 自带过期时间的两天 beta 是新发布形态。V4.1 Flash 原生多模态与 300+ tokens/s，是否意在让 Flash 顶替 Pro——订阅模型速评。
